title: Razorpay Webhook Event
description: Request payload for POST /webhooks/razorpay — Razorpay's own webhook envelope, forwarded verbatim. Shape and fields vary by event type; this schema only documents the fields this route itself reads (event, payload.payment.entity.id, payload.refund.entity.id) for audit metadata extraction. The full payload is persisted as-is for later processing (M4b) and is not otherwise validated against this schema at runtime — signature verification (X-Razorpay-Signature) is what actually authenticates a request, not payload shape.

entity.description: Always "event" for a Razorpay webhook delivery.

event.description: Razorpay event type. Extracted into the pending-events store and audit trail when present.
